candidate.name: Sri Lakshmi Sravya Reddy Kovvuri
candidate.title: Certified Professional Coder (CPC) & Former Dentist
candidate.summary: Certified Professional Coder (CPC) combining hands-on clinical experience as a licensed dentist with expertise in ICD-10-CM, CPT, and HCPCS coding systems. Proven track record in clinical documentation, medical necessity verification, and revenue cycle management alignment. Highly skilled in bridging the gap between provider clinical intent and compliant healthcare data submission to minimize claim denials and optimize reimbursement workflows.

highlights: Diagnosed and treated diverse patient populations, producing precise electronic clinical documentation aligned with diagnostic criteria.
Partnered with billing staff to review insurance claims, decipher clinical chart entries, and ensure proper coding alignment prior to submission.
Streamlined patient record management processes to enhance document accuracy, ensuring strict adherence to healthcare privacy standards.
Delivered comprehensive oral healthcare services while maintaining detailed clinical logs and treatment plans.
Evaluated patient records for accuracy, completeness, and clinical consistency to reduce administrative errors and delays.
Interfaced with cross-functional staff to resolve insurance billing inquiries and verify coverage eligibility.
